searchText: Part of the goal of the 2929+30 combo is definitely to "set the stage" for a more proper separated access pricing reform down the road What is the argument for the mempool being so large? My gut (which is likely wrong or missing information) tells me that we can minimize network noise by just keeping `n` blocks worth of transactions where `n` is a number on the order of 5 to 10. We want to hang on to enough transactions such that if there is a series of quick blocks we can fill them all (as a miner) and when we receive a block we don't have to re-fetch a transaction we previously evicted from peers (as a non-mining node).
